auto_actions.title: Auto-actions
auto_actions.description: Configure how nodate-flow autonomously manages tasks in this workspace. When enabled, the system periodically evaluates tasks and applies actions like escalating overdue items or closing stale reviews.

enabled.label: Enable auto-actions
enabled.description: Allow the system to automatically apply actions to tasks.

interval.label: Evaluation interval
interval.description: How often the system checks tasks and applies actions.

threshold.label: Confidence threshold
threshold.description: Minimum confidence score required for an action to be applied automatically. Lower values apply more actions; higher values are more conservative.

rules.title: Rule configuration
rules.description: Enable or disable individual rules and adjust their sensitivity.

escalate_overdue.label: Escalate overdue
escalate_overdue.description: Bumps priority when a task passes its due date.

assign_owner.label: Assign owner
assign_owner.description: Suggests an owner when a task has no assignee and has been idle.

nudge_assignee.label: Nudge assignee
nudge_assignee.description: Suggests a nudge when an assigned task has no progress.

close_stale_review.label: Close stale review
close_stale_review.description: Closes reviews that have been open without activity.
